original_question: Sara na-achọ ịzụtara onwe ya jakeeti na akpụkpọ ụkwụ abụọ. Jakeeti ọ chọrọ nọ na ọnụ ahia $30 na otu akpụkpọ ụkwụ nọ na ọnụ ahia $20. Sara na-elekọta ụmụaka onye agbataobi ya ugboro anọ ma na-enweta $5 oge ọbụla o lekọtara ha. Nnenanna ya na-akwụ ya $4 oge ọbụla ọ sụrụ ahịhịa ụlọ. Ọ bụrụ na Sara e nwelarị $10 echekwara tupu o bido ọrụ nlekọta ụmụaka, ugboro ole ka ọ ga-asụriri ahịhịa ụlọ ahụ tupu onwe ị́ké ịzụta jakeeti na akpụkpọ ụkwụ ndị ahụ? .
question_template: {name_female, Sara} na-achọ ịzụtara onwe ya jakeeti na akpụkpọ ụkwụ {num_digit_1, 2}. Jakeeti ọ chọrọ nọ na ọnụ ahia ${num_digit_2, 30} na otu akpụkpọ ụkwụ nọ na ọnụ ahia ${num_digit_3, 20}. {name_female, Sara} na-elekọta ụmụaka onye agbataobi ya ugboro {num_digit_4, 4} ma na-enweta ${num_digit_5, 5} oge ọbụla o lekọtara ha. Nnenanna ya na-akwụ ya ${num_digit_6, 4} oge ọbụla ọ sụrụ ahịhịa ụlọ. Ọ bụrụ na {name_female, Sara} e nwelarị ${num_digit_7, 10} echekwara tupu o bido ọrụ nlekọta ụmụaka, ugboro ole ka ọ ga-asụriri ahịhịa ụlọ ahụ tupu onwe ị́ké ịzụta jakeeti na akpụkpọ ụkwụ ndị ahụ? .
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_2 + num_digit_1 * num_digit_3 - (num_digit_7 + num_digit_4 * num_digit_5)) / num_digit_6
